# Offline deployment probe provenance

`probe.py` is project-authored test code under the repository MIT license. Its tiny
color-video and sine-wave sources reuse the CC0-1.0 expressions documented in
`../media/README.md`; all generated files live in the container's disposable tmpfs.
No third-party creative media or real bot credentials are included. Fake token files
are generated by `scripts/smoke-container.sh` and removed on exit.

The probe uses installed runtime modules/tools only, compares each original stream's
encoded packet SHA256 values to the stream-copy result, and checks UID/GID 10001,
capabilities, no-new-privileges, read-only root/secret, denied secret access and bounded
writable scratch. Injected clock/state verifies local heartbeat decisions without
network, sleeps, polling or claims of real bot readiness. The shell also exercises
the real CLI's fake-token success and failure paths and inspects Docker's effective
production restrictions. This fixture is mounted read-only; it is never in the image.
